title: Jamaican Chicken Skewers
description: A keto-friendly recipe for Jamaican chicken skewers, marinated in a spicy and mildly flavored sauce. Perfect for a quick and tasty dinner.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together jerk seasoning, allspice, paprika, garlic powder, and salt.
Add the chicken to the bowl and toss to coat with the spice mixture.
Thread the marinated chicken onto the skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
Brush the tops of the skewers with coconut oil.
Heat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Cook the skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until the chicken is cooked through.
Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve immediately.
